summary: Audit predicates do not govern emitted verdicts, so contradictory positive conclusions can exit 0.
The report claims seeded replay, but code computes only marginals and pool-size arithmetic.
Headline checks accept loose ranges or strict subsets of required budgets and layers.
Transfer and toxicchat companion values cited by the report are never loaded by the executable audit.
The self-test does not render or assert the promised per-claim MISS lines and aggregate.
A text-only control remains required before making representational-mechanism claims.
